versions.changelog:
Initial release of abe-create-content.

- Guides users from rough idea to platform-optimized content for X (Twitter) and LinkedIn.
- Emphasizes exploration and clarifying insights before drafting.
- Provides platform-specific writing formats and viral mechanics.
- Enforces a casual, authentic voice with clear do’s and don’ts.
- Includes fast-track commands to skip or extend phases.
- Built-in voice calibration and red-flag checks to avoid AI-sounding content.
